title: model-switcher classifier
description: Learned prompt-routing weights. Deliberately tool-agnostic: applying it needs only a JSON parser and the ability to split a string into words.

schema_version.description: Consumers must ignore an artifact whose version they do not recognise.

generated_at.description: Metadata only. Never read while scoring — scoring must stay deterministic.

generator.description: What produced this file, e.g. model-switcher/analyze_history.

corpus.description: Aggregate counts describing the evidence. Contains no prompt text.

max_adjustment.description: Absolute cap on the summed adjustment, so a skewed artifact cannot dominate a host's own signals.

min_session_support.description: How many distinct sessions a term had to appear in to be included.

terms.description: term -> weight. Positive predicts substantial work, negative predicts a lookup.
